_comment: Shared PDF-language cases, ticket 76, read by extension/test/reflow.test.mjs (normalizeLangTag + declarationContradicted + detectLang, the viewer's pdfDocumentLang order) and internal/textutil TestDeclarationContradicted (DeclarationContradicted only - the desktop does not read PDF /Lang yet and never guesses a language). declared is the raw /Lang value; agree says whether the text leaves the declaration standing (the guard's answer); want is the language the extension viewer ends up putting on <html lang> (empty string when it puts none). A declaration is trusted only when the text does not contradict it: the sample's dominant script must be one the declared language is written in. See docs/PARITY.md, 'Declared source language'.
